name: Disposable Shoe Covers
description: Disposable shoe covers are designed to help maintain hygiene and cleanliness by minimizing the transfer of dirt, dust, and contaminants from footwear. Ideal for hospitals, clinics, laboratories, cleanrooms, healthcare facilities, and other controlled environments, they provide a convenient solution for everyday infection prevention and facility hygiene. Available in lightweight, easy-to-wear designs for single-use applications.
